paper_title: Knowing You Don't Know Learning When to Continue Search in Multi-round   RAG through Self-Practicing
caption: Ablation study on different Inner Monologue turns on HotPotQA. The green line represents the Naive Generation baseline, while the blue line shows the performance of SIM-RAGlite. The red line indicates the EM score using the ground-truth label as an Oracle Critic.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of turns of inner monologue and the Exact Match (EM) score, measured as a percentage, for three different approaches. The x-axis, labeled "Turns of Inner Monologue," has a linear scale with a value range of 0 to 6, and tick labels at regular intervals of 1. The y-axis, labeled "EM (%)", also has a linear scale with a value range of 0 to 50, and tick labels at intervals of 10. The plot features three lines: a red line representing SIM-RAG (Oracle Critic), a blue line representing SIM-RAG (lite), and a green line representing Naive Gen. The red line starts at around 20% EM and increases to around 48% EM, with a steady upward trend. The blue line starts at around 5% EM and increases to around 30% EM, also showing a steady upward trend. The green line remains relatively flat, starting at around 20% EM and staying at that level throughout.
